meta.name: Volunteer-CGIS
meta.full_name: Village Volunteer-Assisted Citizen Grievance Intelligence System
meta.description: AI-driven rural grievance management platform: volunteers register complaints on behalf of citizens; AI extracts problems, locations, priority, detects duplicates, and routes to departments.
Phone-based OTP login for citizens, email/password admin login, JWT access and refresh tokens.
Volunteers register complaints on behalf of citizens with text and file/image/PDF evidence upload.
Status workflow (Submitted â†’ In Review â†’ Resolved...), timeline, department and citizen views of complaints.
OCR of uploaded images/scans/PDFs (pytesseract, OpenCV preprocessing, PyMuPDF/pdfplumber) before NLP analysis.
Text normalization, problem extraction, keyword extraction, location extraction, department detection, priority prediction, summary generation.
Semantic similarity clustering of complaints to detect duplicates and surface problem clusters for admins.
Admin analytics dashboards, SLA monitoring, report generation and export.
Super-admin management of users, volunteers, departments and settings.
In-app notifications for status changes and escalations.
Audit trail of sensitive actions via middleware and audit-log endpoints.
Layout, sidebar, navbar, protected routes, landing page, shared UI components, API client.

label: Frontend must never call ai-service directly
AI failures must not block complaint registration
Volunteer is the primary registration path
